title: AGENT_QUERY (Executor to one agent, architecture-change-04)
$comment: @akili-spec changes/cicd-executor-poc architecture-change-04 §6, §9.3. Evidence query for a silent or held execution. Sent to the command's FIFO group (MessageGroupId = targetId) with MessageDeduplicationId = <commandId>:q<queryNumber>, so a pending copy of the command is processed first. FIFO order alone is NOT evidence: the agent answers NEVER_SEEN only when the journal can prove it (commandIssuedAt after the journal epoch, inside the retention, and after notAfter plus skew); otherwise NO_RECORD. commandIssuedAt and notAfter are the command's own values, so the agent can apply that rule without having the command.
